info.title: maklaGo API
info.description: Restaurant POS backend. **Tenant**: optional header `x-tenant-id` (slug or registry UUID). With `Authorization: Bearer` staff JWT, the tenant is resolved from the token when the header is omitted. **Language**: optional header **`lang`** (`fr`, `en`, `ar`; default **`fr`**) on every request — error messages and localized strings follow it; response includes **`Content-Language`**. **`POST /api/v1/auth/login`** accepts optional `x-tenant-id` for tenant-scoped login; without it, the normalized email must exist in registry **`staff_login_directory`** (slugless directory login). **`GET /api/v1/orders`** returns enriched catalog labels on lines (dashboard); **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** uses a slimmer shell than **`POST /orders`**: no **`staff`**, no nested **`table`** object; dine-in adds root **`tableId`** + **`tableNumber`**. Lines add **`products[].name`**, **`extras[].name`**, optional **`extras[].typeId`**, optional **`compositionSnapshot`**. **`POST /api/v1/orders`** accepts **`products`** snapshots (`categoryId`, `id`, `count`, **`price`**, **`extras`**) for analytics; **`subtotal`**, **`tva`**, **`total`** use major currency units in JSON (e.g. 2.5); DB keeps cents internally (must match server); new orders start as **`waiting`**. **Platform** routes use `x-platform-key`. Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`.

servers.description: Same origin as this server (set to http://localhost:3000 in dev)

hasPin.description: A PIN is configured (set by owner or platform admin).

requiresMobilePin.description: True when PIN exists and the user has the mobile gate enabled — prompt for PIN on gated flows.

pinMobileEnabled.description: When true, mobile should require PIN for gated flows if a PIN is configured on this account.

currentPin.description: Required when disabling the gate while a PIN is set.

orderType.description: dine_in requires tableId; takeaway must omit tableId.

tableId.description: Restaurant table id (12 lowercase hex, or legacy UUID).

note.description: Optional note for the whole order / ticket.

discount.description: Order-level discount percent (0–100). Decimal JSON numbers accepted (e.g. 10.0).

paymentMethod.description: Always **unpaid** on create. Record **cash** / **card** later via **PATCH /orders/{id}/payment**.

subtotal.description: Sum of line net totals (before order discount) in major currency units; must match server.

tva.description: Sum of line TVA amounts in major currency units; must match server.

total.description: Final total after discount in major currency units; must match server.

products.description: Saved line snapshots for statistics. Money fields use major currency units (e.g. 2.5). Line total = count × price + Σ(extra.price × extra.count). Cashier POST creates orders as `confirmed`.

categoryId.description: Must match the product's category in catalog.

price.description: Base unit price in major currency units (before extras).
Extra unit price in major currency units (same unit as line)

StaffSettableOrderStatus.description: Cashier/kitchen lifecycle. `waiting` is reserved for future QR/web intake and cannot be PATCHed.

PatchOrderStatusRequest.description: Transitions: confirmed → preparing | completed | canceled; preparing → completed | canceled.

tableId.description: Active restaurant table id for this dine-in order.

EditOrderRequest.description: Replace entire cart on an open order. Same line/total rules as create (without orderType/tableId).

OrderProductSummary.description: Product on an order line — aligned with catalog product JSON (id, categoryName, price + priceCents, resolved image URL).

OrderProductSerialized.description: Order line in **`products[]`**. **`POST /orders`** and realtime payloads omit optional **`name`**, **`extras[].name`**, **`extras[].typeId`**. **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** adds **`name`**, **`extras[].name`**, and **`extras[].typeId`** (composition **`CompositionType`** id for that extra when linked via **`composition_type_extras`** + product steps). Optional **`compositionSnapshot`** when stored on the line.

name.description: Product display name. Present on **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** only.

price.description: Saved base unit price for this line (major currency units).

name.description: Extra label when **`id`** matches a catalog extra. Present on **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`**.

typeId.description: Selected composition slot id (**`CompositionType.id`**) for this extra. **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** only, when the extra is linked for this product’s composition steps.

OrderProductEnriched.description: Backoffice order line: product/category labels and resolved extra names joined from catalog.

price.description: Saved base unit price for this line (major currency units).

OrderTableSerialized.description: Table row embedded on dine-in orders. Display label is **`T` + `tableNumber`** (no separate name field). **`zone`** is null when the table has no zone.

OrderSerialized.description: Slim order (**`POST /orders`** response body `order`, realtime **`order.*`**). **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** omits **`staff`** and nested **`table`**, adds root **`tableNumber`** with **`tableId`** for dine-in; enriched lines (**`OrderProductSerialized`**). **`table`** / **`staff`** objects appear on **`POST`** / realtime only.

reference.description: Unique ticket reference: **8** lowercase hexadecimal characters for newly created orders.

tableId.description: Present only for dine-in orders with an assigned table.

tableNumber.description: On **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** only, next to **`tableId`** for dine-in. Omitted on **`POST /orders`** / realtime (nested **`table`** carries display info there).

subtotal.description: Sum of line net totals (major currency units).

tva.description: Sum of line TVA amounts (major currency units).

total.description: Final total after discount (major currency units).

table.description: On **`POST /orders`** / realtime when the table row was loaded. **Not** returned on **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** (use root **`tableId`** + **`tableNumber`**).

staff.description: On **`POST /orders`** / realtime when loaded. **Not** returned on **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`**.

KitchenOrder.description: Kitchen / KDS payload — no prices, payment, or staff. WebSocket **`kitchen.order.*`** uses the same shape.

isChanged.description: True when cartRevision > kitchenSeenRevision (cashier edited cart).

OrderSerializedEnriched.description: Backoffice order (`GET /orders`, `GET /orders/{id}`, `PATCH …/status` HTTP body): enriched **`products`** (`OrderProductEnriched`). Shell matches **`OrderSerialized`** (table rules, `staff`, etc.).

reference.description: Unique ticket reference: **8** lowercase hexadecimal characters for newly created orders.

tableId.description: Present only for dine-in orders with an assigned table.

subtotal.description: Sum of line net totals (major currency units).

tva.description: Sum of line TVA amounts (major currency units).

total.description: Final total after discount (major currency units).

table.description: Present only with `tableId` on dine-in orders when table row was loaded.

tableNumber.description: Numeric label; **unique together with `zoneId`** (different zones may reuse the same number).

zoneId.description: **POST /tables**: required — table numbers are unique **per zone**. **PATCH**: optional; omit keys you are not updating.

status.description: Patch only; normally derived from open dine-in orders.

TableZone.description: Dining area / floor section. **`RestaurantTable.zoneId`** references this; delete is blocked while tables still reference the zone (`409 zone_has_tables`). Zone **`name`** is unique.

MobileTableInZone.description: Active table nested under a zone on **`GET /api/v1/mobile/zones`**. No **`zone`** / **`zoneId`** — the parent zone is authoritative.

ownerPin.description: Optional 4-digit PIN for owner (requires owner fields together).

ProvisionTenantRequest.description: If any owner field is set, all four owner fields are required. ownerPin requires the owner quartet.

BootstrapOwnerRequest.description: Allowed only while the tenant database has no active staff with role owner.

CashShiftFilter.description: Shift period. Use **`custom`** with **`startDate`** / **`endDate`** to close a previous day (e.g. yesterday — set both to the same `YYYY-MM-DD`). Boundaries use **Africa/Tunis**.

CashShiftTotals.description: Grand total and payment split count **completed** orders only. Amounts in major currency units.

orderCount.description: Non-canceled active tickets in period (confirmed + preparing + completed).

ordersDetailed.description: Same shape as **`GET /api/v1/orders`** enriched list items.

startDate.description: Required for `filter=custom`. Pick a single shift day: use the same value for **`endDate`** (e.g. both `2026-05-22` for yesterday).

endDate.description: Required for `filter=custom`. Same as **`startDate`** for one-day shift close.

escPosBase64.description: Raw ESC/POS for future printer integration.

openDrawer.description: False until cash drawer is wired.

closedBy.description: Staff id who closed the shift.

StatisticsResponse.description: Dashboard statistics (amounts in major currency units, e.g. 2.5 TND). Period boundaries use Africa/Tunis.

schema.description: Order public id (lowercase hex or legacy UUID).

TenantHeaderOptional.name: x-tenant-id
TenantHeaderOptional.description: Tenant slug (e.g. demo) or registry tenant UUID. Optional when the request includes a valid staff Bearer JWT—the server resolves tenant from the token.

LangHeader.name: lang
LangHeader.description: Preferred language for error messages and localized API strings. Also accepted as query `lang`. Unsupported values fall back to `fr`. Response header `Content-Language` echoes the resolved language.

CashShiftFilterQuery.name: filter
CashShiftFilterQuery.description: Shift window. **`custom`** + dates closes a specific day (e.g. forgotten yesterday shift).

CashShiftStartDateQuery.name: startDate
CashShiftStartDateQuery.description: With **`filter=custom`**: inclusive start (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Africa/Tunis). For a single shift day, set **`startDate`** and **`endDate`** to the same value.

CashShiftEndDateQuery.name: endDate
CashShiftEndDateQuery.description: With **`filter=custom`**: inclusive end (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Africa/Tunis). Same as **`startDate`** for one-day shift.

get.summary: Get tenant by id or slug

delete.description: Deletes the registry row (owners cascade). Does not drop the tenant PostgreSQL database.

post.summary: Bootstrap first owner when tenant was created without one

201.description: Owner staff and registry owner created

409.description: Tenant already has an active owner, duplicate email, or directory conflict

get.description: Includes PIN summary flags for owners (hash never exposed).

post.description: Issues a staff JWT. Omit `x-tenant-id` when the normalized email exists in `staff_login_directory` (registry); otherwise send `x-tenant-id` to select the tenant database.

patch.description: Any authenticated staff member (owner, manager, cashier) may change **their own** password. Requires current password, new password, and confirmation. Min 8 characters for the new password.
PIN digits are set/cleared only by the owner (backoffice). Any staff member with a PIN can enable or disable whether mobile must verify it. Disabling while a PIN exists requires `currentPin`.

put.description: Sets a 4-digit PIN on **manager** or **cashier** staff. Owners may set their own PIN; other owners are managed via platform admin.

get.description: Active categories with nested active products (mobile-only slim JSON). Categories, products, composition slots, and extras use `id`. Includes `kind` (`simple`|`composed`), category name string field `category`, and `type` with `extras`.

post.description: owner or manager only. Multipart form field `file` (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF).

path.description: Portable value to store on entities: uploads/<tenantId>/<filename>

url.description: Absolute URL for the same file (derived from Host or PUBLIC_BASE_URL)

get.description: Selectable add-ons for composed-product composition steps.

200.description: OK — body includes `extras` array (Mongo-shaped fields: price, suppPrice, etc.)

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Pass `true` or `1` to include inactive types

put.description: owner or manager only. Sets ordered junction rows for which extras belong to this step.

200.description: OK — returns updated composition type + extras

post.description: Assigns `reference`, `commandNumber`, and `commandDate` (UTC day). Status is **`confirmed`** for cashier-created orders (dine-in table occupied when applicable). Body **`products`**: line net = count×price + Σ(extra.price×extra.count); **`subtotal`**, **`tva`**, **`total`** must match server (major currency units in JSON). For composed products send resolved **`extras`** client-side.

get.description: Returns **`orders[]`** with **`OrderSerializedEnriched`** — catalog labels on lines for dashboard/backoffice. Mobile apps use **`GET /api/v1/mobile/orders`** — same shell as realtime with **`products[].name`**, **`extras[].name`**, optional **`extras[].typeId`** on each line.

patch.description: Replace all lines on **confirmed** or **preparing** orders. Broadcasts **order.updated**. Resets **paymentMethod** to **unpaid** if previously paid.

Kitchen/cashier lifecycle: **confirmed** → **preparing** → **completed**, or **canceled** from **confirmed**/**preparing**. Dine-in table occupancy refreshes on change. Broadcasts **order.updated** and **table.updated** when applicable.
Sets **`paymentMethod`** to **`cash`** or **`card`**. Order id is in the path. Broadcasts **`order.updated`** on the staff WebSocket. Not allowed on **canceled** orders.

patch.summary: Move dine-in order to another table
patch.description: Updates **`tableId`** on an open dine-in order (`confirmed` or `preparing`). Refreshes occupancy on old and new tables. Broadcasts **`order.updated`** and **`table.updated`** on the staff WebSocket. Target table must not already have another **`confirmed`** or **`preparing`** dine-in order.

400.description: Validation / not dine-in / order closed / table not found

get.description: Audit trail for one order (create, cart edit, status, payment, table move). Newest first.
Filter by **entityType**, **entityId**, and/or **action**. Defaults to latest 50 rows.

Paginated order history for mobile (like legacy getHistory). Default **10** per page. Filter by **`filter`** (`all`, `today`, `week`, `month`, `custom` with **`startDate`** / **`endDate`**), **`status`**, **`orderType`**, **`tableId`**, or **`search`** (ticket number, reference, customer name). Period boundaries use **Africa/Tunis**.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Ticket number, reference, or customer name.

get.description: Returns the latest **confirmed** or **preparing** dine-in order for **tableId**, or **`order: null`**.
**`OrderSerialized`** — mobile shell (**`tableId`** + **`tableNumber`**, no **`staff`** / nested **`table`**); enriched lines.

patch.description: Same as **PATCH /api/v1/orders/{id}**; response uses mobile **OrderSerialized** (line names, extras labels). Broadcasts **order.updated**.

get.description: Active **`confirmed`** and **`preparing`** orders for KDS. No prices. Includes **`isChanged`** when the cashier edited the cart.

patch.description: Sets **`kitchenSeenRevision`** to **`cartRevision`**, clearing **`isChanged`** on kitchen clients.

get.description: Each zone includes **`tables[]`** (active rows only, same ordering as **`GET /tables`**). Use table **`id`** as **`tableId`** on dine-in orders.
Returns all zones ordered by **`sortOrder`**, then **`name`**. Use **`id`** as **`zoneId`** when creating or moving tables.

delete.description: Hard delete. Fails with **`409 zone_has_tables`** if any **`RestaurantTable`** still references this zone (FK **Restrict**).

post.description: Sets **`status`** to the opposite of the current value and emits **`table.updated`** on the staff WebSocket.

get.description: Ticket **#**, **reference**, and **total** per order, plus shift totals. **Manager/owner only.** Use **`filter=custom`** with **`startDate`** / **`endDate`** (same day) to close a previous shift (e.g. yesterday). Grand total = **completed** orders only. Period boundaries: **Africa/Tunis**.
Full enriched orders (products, extras, prices) for the shift period + totals. **Manager/owner only.** Supports **`filter=custom`** + date pick for past shifts.

post.description: Closes the shift for the selected period and returns summary + **`printJob`** (ESC/POS). **`hardware.print`** is null and **`hardware.openDrawer`** is false until printer/drawer are configured. Example body for yesterday: `{ "filter": "custom", "startDate": "2026-05-22", "endDate": "2026-05-22" }`.

get.description: Legacy-style POS statistics adapted to maklaGo orders. **`filter`**: `today` (default), `week`, `month`, `year`, or `custom`. Optional **`startDate`** / **`endDate`** (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Africa/Tunis day boundaries) override the filter range. Revenue includes non-canceled orders (`waiting`, `confirmed`, `preparing`, `completed`). Amounts in major currency units.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on order createdAt

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound on order createdAt
